# EU DPP Provider — Complete Architectural & Compliance Specification

## 1. Executive Summary
EU DPP Provider (https://eudppprovider.com) provides enterprise-grade compliance software and sovereign data vault infrastructure for manufacturers, pack assemblers, and automotive OEMs subject to the European Union's Battery Regulation (Regulation EU 2023/1542) and Ecodesign for Sustainable Products Regulation (ESPR, Regulation EU 2024/1781).

## 2. Regulatory Framework & Definitive Deadlines
- **20 July 2026 [In Force]**: European Commission DG GROW Central DPP Registry entered operational status (`registry.product-passport.ec.europa.eu`).
- **18 August 2026 [In Force]**: Mandatory Carbon Footprint performance class labeling (A–E) applicable to EV traction batteries.
- **18 February 2027 [Mandatory Enforcement]**: All EV batteries, LMT batteries (≤25kg), and industrial batteries (>2kWh) placed on the EU market must carry an electronic Battery Passport accessible via a permanent GS1 Digital Link 2D QR code (Regulation EU 2023/1542, Articles 77 & 78).
- **18 August 2027 [Mandatory Enforcement]**: Mandatory supply chain due diligence policies and third-party audit conformity verification under Regulation (EU) 2025/1561.
- **18 February 2028 [Statutory Target]**: Maximum lifecycle carbon footprint thresholds enforced for EV batteries.
- **18 August 2028 [Statutory Target]**: Mandatory recycled content documentation declarations (Cobalt, Lithium, Nickel, Lead).
- **18 August 2031 [Statutory Target]**: Mandatory recycled content minimum percentage targets enforced (Cobalt 16%, Lead 85%, Lithium 6%, Nickel 6%).

## 3. The 3-Layer Data Architecture
1. **Upstream Ingestion Layer**: Read-only integration with factory MES, ERP (SAP/Oracle/Siemens), PLM, and battery testing systems (BMS). Aligns mandatory EU 90+ data attributes with domestic battery traceability codes.
2. **Cleanroom & Zero-Knowledge Verification Layer**: In-country computation with strict whitelist export. Proprietary chemical formulations and commercial BOM pricing are mathematically verified via Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP) without transmitting raw trade secrets across borders.
3. **European Sovereign Storage & Public Resolver**: Hosted in ISO/IEC 27001 certified data centers in Frankfurt am Main and Munich. Delivers sub-50ms global DNS resolution for customs officers, test laboratories, and consumers.

## 5. Commercial Models
- **Early Adopter Pilot (€4,800)**: 1–3 SKUs, full gap analysis, Frankfurt sandbox deployment, DG GROW pre-validation.
- **10-Year Managed Sovereign Vault (From €12,500/yr)**: Turnkey data hosting in Frankfurt. Includes 99.9% uptime SLA, 30-day regulatory updates, and official DG GROW registry filing support.
- **Enterprise DPP Software Suite**: Perpetual license or annual subscription for on-premise / private cloud hosting. Includes complete source access, zero scan fees, and pre-built MES connectors.
